bio.text: Scott Bottoms is a Republican who represents District 15 (El Paso County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 9, 2023; Ballotpedia lists him as not running for re-election in 2026.

According to Ballotpedia, Bottoms served in the U.S. Navy and earned an undergraduate degree in church ministries from Southwestern Assemblies of God University, a master's degree in intercultural leadership and a doctorate in intercultural spiritual leadership.
It lists his career experience as pastor of Church at Briargate.
